operatorReply.subject: [{service}] You have a reply to your feedback
operatorReply.heading: You have a reply to your feedback.
operatorReply.headingNamed: Hi {name}, you have a reply to your feedback.
operatorReply.sub2: To follow up, write in the chat window on {service}. It goes straight to the owner.
operatorReply.hlLead: If you have a question about the reply, or something still does not work, tell us in the chat window.
operatorReply.hlBody1: It stays in the same conversation, so the owner sees the full context.
operatorReply.hlBody2: When the problem is fixed, we will email you that too.
operatorReply.note: A reply to this email goes to the owner's inbox, but only what you write in the chat window is kept on record.
operatorReply.footer: You are receiving this because you left feedback on {service}. · Sent by Feedloop on behalf of {service}
operatorReply.textRecord: Only what you write in the chat window is kept on record. We will also email you when the problem is fixed.

loopClosed.subject: [{service}] The problem you reported is fixed
loopClosed.heading: The problem you reported is fixed.
loopClosed.headingNamed: Hi {name}, the problem you reported is fixed.
loopClosed.sub1: We fixed {service} based on your feedback. It may take a few more minutes to appear on the live site.
loopClosed.sub2: Thank you for telling us. Let us know in the chat window whether it works now.
loopClosed.note: You can see the same message in the chat window.
loopClosed.hlLead: Try the changed screen yourself. If it is still the same, tell us in the same chat window.
loopClosed.hlBody: The owner will look again right away. A short "it works" helps too.
loopClosed.footer: You are receiving this because you left feedback on {service}. · Sent by Feedloop on behalf of {service}
loopClosed.textStill: If it is still the same, tell us in the same chat window.

handoff.subjectNotFixed: [{service}] Marked as fixed, but the visitor says it is not · {visitor}

handoff.headingNotFixed: {visitor} says it is still not fixed.
handoff.sub1: They pressed "Talk to a person" in the {service} widget.
handoff.sub2: They are waiting for a person, not the AI. Reply in the Inbox and it reaches the widget right away.
handoff.sub2Mail: They are waiting for a person, not the AI. Reply in the Inbox and it reaches the widget and their email right away.
handoff.subNotFixed1: {service} told this visitor the problem was fixed, and they answered that it is still the same.
handoff.subNotFixed2: That group is under follow-up, so new PRs are on hold. Reply to the visitor in the Inbox and find out what is left.
handoff.s1Title: What the visitor left for a person
handoff.noMessage: They pressed the button without leaving a message. See the recent conversation below.
handoff.noMessageNotFixed: There is no message. See the original report in the recent conversation below.
handoff.hlLead: Do not reply to this email. Reply in the Feedloop Inbox.
handoff.hlBody: Only replies sent there reach the visitor's widget and stay on record. Replying also clears the "Needs reply" badge.
handoff.footer: This mail goes to the owner of the {service} bot when a visitor asks for a person. · Feedloop
handoff.footerNotFixed: This mail goes to the owner of the {service} bot when a visitor says a fix did not work. · Feedloop
handoff.textHead: {visitor} wants to talk to a person.
handoff.textHeadNotFixed: {visitor} says it is still the same.
handoff.textDoNotReply: Do not reply to this email. Reply in the Feedloop Inbox.

newConversation.subject: [{service}] New conversation · {visitor} "{snippet}"
newConversation.heading: {visitor} started a conversation.
newConversation.sub1: A new visitor sent their first message in the {service} widget. The AI reply and the rest of the conversation are in the Inbox.
newConversation.sub2: You get this mail once, when a conversation opens. Follow the rest in the Inbox.
newConversation.hlLead: To reply, use the Feedloop Inbox. A reply to this email does not reach the visitor.
newConversation.hlBody: If the AI can't answer, the "Needs reply" badge turns on. If the visitor presses "Talk to a person", you get a separate email.
newConversation.footer: This mail goes to the owner of the {service} bot when a new conversation opens. One mail per conversation. · Feedloop
newConversation.textHead: {visitor} started a conversation in the {service} widget.
newConversation.textOnce: You get this mail once, when a conversation opens. Reply in the Feedloop Inbox.

refund.subject: [{service}] Refund approval needed · {amount} · {visitor}
refund.noAuto: Automatic refunds are switched off for this store.
refund.heading: {visitor} is asking for a {amount} refund.
refund.sub: The refund did not meet {service}'s automatic-refund rules, so it is waiting for you in the Feedloop inbox. Nothing has been sent to PayPal.
refund.s3Title: Approve or reject in the inbox
refund.hlLead: Open the conversation and use the Approve / Reject buttons on the refund request.
refund.hlBody: Approving sends the refund to PayPal with the exact amount above. Rejecting tells the visitor in the widget. Either way this request can only be decided once.
refund.footer: This mail goes to the owner of the {service} bot when a refund needs a person. · Feedloop
refund.textNothing: Nothing has been sent to PayPal. Approve or reject the refund request in the Feedloop Inbox.
